headline: UK: AI hacking tools exposing years of weak security
pages: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre says it has seen a marked rise in AI-driven cyberattacks in recent months. Since September, several incidents have involved autonomous hacking tools, including penetration testing software meant for defenders, causing intrusions and downtime at organizations. The agency says none of the weaknesses being exploited are new, but the tools carry out simple hacks much faster than before. Open source autonomous testing tools released this year, such as Artex and Cairn, are free for anyone to download. The US FBI recently issued a similar warning.

The NCSC's message is that many of these attacks are preventable with basic security practices, because the flaws being exploited are simple, unaddressed weaknesses rather than novel vulnerabilities. Source: TechCrunch.
